speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: NParks also partners agencies and Town Councils to educate the community on proper refuse management.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We would like to remind the public to be socially responsible by not feeding wild birds, and by keeping public areas clean and free of food waste, to help manage wildlife population.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the order of the day.
